title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 1,001–1,050 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: In Taiwan, an eighteen-year-old is considered a legal adult.
examples.zh: 在台灣，年滿十八歲即被視為法定成年人。

examples.en: Adult admission tickets to the art museum cost three hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 參觀這座美術館的成人全票費用為三百元。

examples.en: With adulthood comes greater freedom as well as serious responsibilities.
examples.zh: 成年伴隨著更大的自由，同時也肩負著重大的責任。

examples.en: Teenagers love sharing short videos on social media.
examples.zh: 青少年喜歡在社群媒體上分享短影音。

examples.en: Many teenagers balance academic schoolwork with sports club training.
examples.zh: 許多青少年在沉重學校課業與運動社團訓練之間努力尋求平衡。

examples.en: It is common for teenagers to seek independence from their parents.
examples.zh: 青少年渴望脫離父母追求獨立自主是很常見的現象。

examples.en: The youth hostel in Hualien is clean, safe, and cheap.
examples.zh: 花蓮這家青年旅館乾淨、安全又便宜。

examples.en: In his youth, my grandfather was an energetic track athlete.
examples.zh: 我的祖父在年輕時代是一位精力充沛的田徑運動員。

examples.en: Civic volunteer programs empower the youth to make meaningful social impacts.
examples.zh: 民間志工計畫賦能青年，使他們為社會帶來實質的正面影響。

examples.en: Please write down your full name and age on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上寫下你的全名和年齡。

examples.en: At the age of seven, she began learning classical violin.
examples.zh: 在七歲那年，她開始學習古典小提琴。

examples.en: We are fortunate to live in a modern digital age with instant information access.
examples.zh: 我們很幸運生活在一個能夠即時獲取資訊的現代數位時代。

examples.en: Gender equality is emphasized in Taiwanese schools.
examples.zh: 台灣學校非常重視性別平等。

examples.en: Traditional assumptions about gender roles have changed significantly over the decades.
examples.zh: 數十年來，關於性別角色的傳統假設已經發生了顯著轉變。

examples.en: Employment decisions must be made fairly regardless of gender or background.
examples.zh: 無論性別或背景為何，企業在招募決策時都必須秉持公正原則。

examples.en: The male population in this district is slightly higher.
examples.zh: 該行政區的男性人口比例略高。

examples.en: The choir consists of thirty female and twenty-five male singers.
examples.zh: 這個合唱團由三十位女歌手與二十五位男歌手組成。

examples.en: In many bird species, the male boasts colorful plumage to attract mates.
examples.zh: 在許多鳥類物種中，雄鳥擁有鮮豔奪目的羽毛以吸引異性。

examples.en: Taiwan has elected its first female president in history.
examples.zh: 台灣選出了歷史上第一位女性總統。

examples.en: More female engineers are leading innovative projects in the tech industry.
examples.zh: 越來越多女性工程師正在科技產業中帶領創新專案。

examples.en: The university established scholarships supporting young female scientists in physics.
examples.zh: 這所大學設立了獎學金，資助投身物理學研究的年輕女科學家。

examples.en: What is your nationality? — I am Taiwanese.
examples.zh: 你的國籍是什麼？— 我是台灣人。

examples.en: Travelers must write their nationality clearly on customs declaration cards.
examples.zh: 旅客必須上海關申報卡上清楚填寫自己的國籍。

examples.en: The international school welcomes students of more than forty different nationalities.
examples.zh: 這所國際學校迎來了來自超過四十個不同國籍的學生。

examples.en: Mandarin is my native language, and I also speak Taiwanese.
examples.zh: 國語是我的母語，我也會講台語。

examples.en: Formosan black bears are magnificent animals native to the mountains of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣黑熊是原產棲息於台灣山區的珍貴特有種雄偉動物。

examples.en: Practicing with native English speakers helps improve natural conversational rhythm.
examples.zh: 與英語母語人士交流練習有助於改善自然流暢的對話節奏。

examples.en: Many foreigners enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of Taiwanese night markets.
examples.zh: 許多外國人喜愛台灣夜市熱鬧的氛圍。

examples.en: Taiwanese people are famous for being warm and hospitable toward foreigners.
examples.zh: 台灣人以對外國人士熱情好客、友善親切而著稱於世。

examples.en: It takes courage to move abroad and live as a foreigner in a distant culture.
examples.zh: 隻身移居異國、在陌生的異域文化中生活需要莫大的勇氣。

examples.en: Senior citizens enjoy discounts on public transportation.
examples.zh: 年長市民享有搭乘大眾運輸的優惠票價。

examples.en: Responsible citizens recycle waste and actively keep their neighborhood clean.
examples.zh: 負責任的公民落實資源回收，並積極維護社區環境整潔。

examples.en: Every citizen has the democratic right and civic duty to cast their vote.
examples.zh: 每一位公民都享有行使民主投票權利與善盡公民義務。

examples.en: Our next-door neighbor kindly helped water our plants.
examples.zh: 我們的隔壁鄰居好心幫忙我們澆花。

examples.en: We exchanged homemade festive cookies with our friendly neighborhood neighbors.
examples.zh: 我們與熱情親切的社區鄰居互相交換自製的節慶餅乾。

examples.en: It is wonderful having considerate neighbors who respect quiet evening hours.
examples.zh: 擁有在夜晚時分懂得輕聲細語、顧及他人的體貼鄰居真是太棒了。

examples.en: Our neighborhood has several convenient parks and cafes.
examples.zh: 我們社區有幾座便利的公園和咖啡廳。

examples.en: Da'an district is a quiet and pleasant neighborhood in central Taipei.
examples.zh: 大安區是台北市中心一個清幽舒適且宜居的優質社區。

examples.en: A friendly community bakery recently opened right in our local neighborhood.
examples.zh: 最近有一家親切溫馨的社區烘焙坊就在我們住家街坊開張了。

examples.en: We visited all our relatives during Chinese New Year.
examples.zh: 我們在農曆新年期間拜訪了所有的親戚。

examples.en: Close relatives gathered from across the island for my grandfather's ninetieth birthday.
examples.zh: 至親親屬從全台各地齊聚一堂慶祝我祖父的九十大壽。

examples.en: The cost of living in southern Taiwan is relatively lower than in Taipei.
examples.zh: 南台灣的生活物價開銷相較於台北而言相對較為親民。

examples.en: My cousin and I were born in the same year.
examples.zh: 我表弟和我出生在同一年。

examples.en: We spent our childhood summer vacations playing at our cousins' farm.
examples.zh: 我們童年的暑假都在表堂兄弟姊妹的農場裡嬉戲玩耍度過。

examples.en: Her first cousin works as a successful pediatric doctor in Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 她的親堂兄在高雄擔任一位成功的出色小兒科醫生。

examples.en: Uncle David lives in Taichung and owns a bakery.
examples.zh: 大衛叔叔住在台中並經營一家麵包店。

examples.en: My uncle taught me how to fish by the scenic riverside when I was young.
examples.zh: 在我年幼時，我的舅舅教我如何在風景秀麗的河畔釣魚。

examples.en: Everyone in the family enjoys listening to Uncle John's humorous travel tales.
examples.zh: 家族裡的每個人都非常喜歡聽約翰叔叔講述他幽默風趣的旅行軼事。

examples.en: Aunt Mary always bakes tasty pineapple cakes for us.
examples.zh: 瑪麗阿姨總是為我們烤美味的鳳梨酥。

examples.en: My aunt is a talented landscape painter whose art exhibits in major galleries.
examples.zh: 我的姑姑是一位富有才華的風景畫家，她的畫作在各大美術館展出。

examples.en: We visited Aunt Susan in Tainan and tasted authentic savory beef soup.
examples.zh: 我們去台南探望蘇珊阿姨，並品嚐了道地鮮甜的清燙牛肉湯。

examples.en: I bought a robot toy for my little nephew's birthday.
examples.zh: 我買了一台機器人玩具送給小姪子當生日禮物。

examples.en: My seven-year-old nephew loves building elaborate castles with plastic blocks.
examples.zh: 我那七歲的小外甥非常喜歡用塑膠積木搭建精緻壯麗的城堡。

examples.en: She felt immense pride watching her nephew perform in the school piano recital.
examples.zh: 看著姪子在學校鋼琴獨奏會上的優雅演出，她感到無比驕傲自豪。

examples.en: My niece loves drawing colorful cartoon characters.
examples.zh: 我的外甥女喜歡畫色彩繽紛的卡通人物。

examples.en: My older brother's daughter is my darling five-year-old niece.
examples.zh: 我哥哥的女兒就是我那五歲聰敏可愛的寶貝姪女。

examples.en: I mailed a set of fairy tale storybooks to my niece for Christmas.
examples.zh: 我寄了一套經典童話故事繪本給我姪女作為聖誕禮物。

examples.en: The newly married couple traveled to Japan for honeymoon.
examples.zh: 這對新婚夫婦去日本度蜜月。

examples.en: We plan to stay in Taitung for a couple of days to relax by the ocean.
examples.zh: 我們打算在台東待上幾天，在海邊放鬆享受愜意時光。

examples.en: An elderly couple walked hand in hand along the peaceful park pathway.
examples.zh: 一對年邁的恩愛夫妻手牽著手漫步在幽靜的公園小徑上。

examples.en: They plan to marry in a garden ceremony next autumn.
examples.zh: 他們計畫明年秋天在花園婚禮中結為連理。

examples.en: He decided to marry his college sweetheart after eight years of dating.
examples.zh: 在交往八年之後，他毅然決定迎娶他的大學初戀女友。

examples.en: Traditional Taiwanese customs surround the ceremonies when two families marry.
examples.zh: 當兩家聯姻結為親家時，伴隨著許多深厚典雅的傳統禮俗。

examples.en: Are you married or single?
examples.zh: 請問你是已婚還是單身？

examples.en: They have been happily married for over thirty fruitful years.
examples.zh: 他們結為連理恩愛相伴已逾三十個幸福美滿的春秋。

examples.en: Married life requires continuous empathy, compromise, and heartfelt teamwork.
examples.zh: 婚姻生活需要持續不斷的同理心、互相包容與真誠的團隊協作。

examples.en: Single tickets can be bought at the station machine.
examples.zh: 單程票可以在車站自動售票機購買。

examples.en: She booked a cozy single room at the boutique city hotel.
examples.zh: 她在市區精品商旅預訂了一間溫馨舒適的單人房。

examples.en: Not a single person arrived late for the important morning keynote.
examples.zh: 沒有任何一個人在此次重要的晨間專題論壇上演講遲到。

examples.en: His parents are divorced, but they both love him deeply.
examples.zh: 他的父母雖然離婚了，但都深愛著他。

examples.en: After becoming divorced, she rediscovered her passion for solo international travel.
examples.zh: 在離婚恢單之後，她重新找回了自己熱愛獨自出國探索世界的熱忱。

examples.en: Counseling services assist divorced parents in co-parenting their children harmoniously.
examples.zh: 專業諮商協談機構協助離異的父母共同和諧撫養陪伴孩子成長。

examples.en: Learning good English is beneficial for your future career.
examples.zh: 學好英語對你未來的職業生涯大有助益。

examples.en: She made a bold career transition from finance to environmental conservation.
examples.zh: 她做出了一次大膽的職涯轉折，從金融界跨足投身生態環境保育。

examples.en: A mentor's guidance can open unexpected doors in your professional career.
examples.zh: 一位良師益友的引導能在你的專業職業生涯中開啟意想不到的機遇。

examples.en: Teaching is a highly respected profession in society.
examples.zh: 教書在社會上是一項備受尊重的專門職業。

examples.en: Doctors and nurses belong to the honorable healthcare medical profession.
examples.zh: 醫師與護理師皆隸屬於崇高神聖的醫療衛生專業從業人員。

examples.en: He is an architect by profession, designing modern sustainable buildings.
examples.zh: 他本職是一名建築師，致力於設計現代綠色永續綠建築。

examples.en: Many software engineers work in Hsinchu Science Park.
examples.zh: 許多軟體工程師在新竹科學園區工作。

examples.en: Civil engineers designed earthquake-resistant structures for the high-speed rail.
examples.zh: 土木工程師為台灣高鐵設計了卓越的耐震耐震工程結構。

examples.en: The clever technician managed to engineer a cost-effective solution to the power leak.
examples.zh: 這位機靈的技術人員成功策劃出了一套經濟高效的漏電防護解方。

words.definition: 程式設計師；軟體工程師

examples.en: Programmers write clean code to build useful applications.
examples.zh: 程式設計師撰寫簡潔代碼以打造實用應用程式。

examples.en: Junior programmers collaborate with senior developers during daily code reviews.
examples.zh: 初階程式設計師在每日代碼審查時與資深開發者緊密協作。

examples.en: Becoming a proficient computer programmer requires logical thinking and perseverance.
examples.zh: 要成為一名熟練優秀的電腦程式設計師需要嚴密的邏輯思維與恆心。

examples.en: The graphic designer created an eye-catching poster.
examples.zh: 平面設計師設計了一張引人注目的海報。

examples.en: World-famous fashion designers unveiled their autumn clothing collections in Paris.
examples.zh: 享譽全球的頂尖時裝設計師在巴黎發表了秋冬新裝系列。

examples.en: User experience designers ensure mobile apps are intuitive and easy to navigate.
examples.zh: 使用者體驗設計師致力於確保手機應用程式直覺流暢且易於操作。

examples.en: Our project manager assigned tasks to everyone fairly.
examples.zh: 我們的專案經理公平地把任務分配給大家。

examples.en: The hotel general manager greeted guests warmly in the executive lounge.
examples.zh: 飯店總經理在行政貴賓廳親切熱情地迎接下榻貴賓。

examples.en: An effective office manager fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace culture.
examples.zh: 一位優秀得力的行政經理能營造充滿團隊協作與相互支持的工作氛圍。

examples.en: The research assistant organized the laboratory equipment.
examples.zh: 研究助理整理了實驗室的設備。

examples.en: The polite shop assistant helped me find the right size denim jacket.
examples.zh: 那位親切有禮的店員協助我找到了合適尺碼的牛仔外套。

examples.en: College teaching assistants lead weekly discussion sessions for undergraduate students.
examples.zh: 大學助教每週帶領大學部學生進行深入的專題討論課程。

examples.en: The executive secretary scheduled tomorrow's board meeting.
examples.zh: 執行秘書排定了明天董事會的時間。

examples.en: The legal secretary prepared all court documents meticulously for the trial.
examples.zh: 法務秘書為即將開庭的審判一絲不苟地備妥了所有訴訟文件。

examples.en: Call the department secretary if you need assistance submitting your university application.
examples.zh: 如果你在繳交大學入學申請資料時需要任何協助，請聯繫系辦秘書。

examples.en: The accountant checked the company's financial balance.
examples.zh: 會計師審核了公司的財務收支平衡表。

examples.en: Companies hire certified public accountants to manage taxes and audits.
examples.zh: 企業聘請執業會計師來統籌管理稅務申報與財務稽核業務。

examples.en: A detail-oriented accountant caught the clerical discrepancy in the quarterly ledger.
examples.zh: 一位細心嚴謹的會計師及時查出了季度總帳中的登載出入。

examples.en: You should consult a qualified lawyer before signing contracts.
examples.zh: 簽署合約前應諮詢合格的律師。

examples.en: The defense lawyer presented compelling evidence that proved the client's innocence.
examples.zh: 辯護律師提出了極具說服力的確鑿證據，證明了當事人的清白。

examples.en: Passing the bar exam to become a licensed practicing lawyer requires years of dedication.
examples.zh: 通過司法官律師高考成為執業律師需要付出多年的辛勤苦讀。

examples.en: The investigative journalist interviewed the mayor today.
examples.zh: 這位調查記者今天採訪了市長。

examples.en: Dedicated foreign journalists report crucial news updates from conflict areas.
examples.zh: 敬業的駐外戰地記者從動盪衝突地區第一線發回至關重要的最新報導。

examples.en: The award-winning photojournalist captured powerful images of the environmental crisis.
examples.zh: 獲獎的攝影記者捕捉到了深刻震撼人心的環境生態危機紀實影像。

examples.en: The wedding photographer captured every joyful moment.
examples.zh: 婚禮攝影師捕捉了每一個歡樂瞬間。

examples.en: Wildlife photographers often wait patiently for hours in freezing temperatures.
examples.zh: 野生動物攝影師經常在刺骨嚴寒的低溫中耐心地守候數個小時。

examples.en: She hired a professional portrait photographer to take corporate profile photos.
examples.zh: 她聘請了一位專業人像攝影師為她拍攝企業商務形象宣傳照。

examples.en: The experienced airline pilot landed the aircraft safely in high winds.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的客機機師在強風中安全降落飛機。

examples.en: Commercial airline pilots undergo rigorous flight simulator training every six months.
examples.zh: 民航客機機師每六個月都要接受極為嚴苛的高仿真模擬機複訓。

examples.en: The municipal government launched a pilot program offering free community shuttle buses.
examples.zh: 市政府推行了一項提供免費社區接駁巴士的試驗性先導計畫。

examples.en: The flight attendant served hot tea and meal trays.
examples.zh: 空服員端送熱茶與餐盤。

examples.en: Friendly flight attendants ensure passengers understand safety evacuation procedures clearly.
examples.zh: 親切的空服員確保機上乘客充分清楚並掌握緊急逃生安全須知。

examples.en: She dreamed of becoming an international flight attendant and traveling globally.
examples.zh: 她夢想著成為一名國際線空服員，能夠一邊工作一邊環遊世界。

examples.en: The executive chef prepared a gourmet five-course meal.
examples.zh: 行政主廚精心準備了精緻的五道菜套餐。

examples.en: Master chefs blend traditional ingredients with innovative modern cooking techniques.
examples.zh: 頂級名廚將傳統在地食材與創新的現代料理廚藝手法融會貫通。

examples.en: The pastry chef crafted an exquisite multi-tiered wedding cake adorned with sugar flowers.
examples.zh: 西點主廚精心烘培了一座點綴著精緻糖花的多層奢華婚禮蛋糕。

examples.en: The waiter brought a glass of lemon water to our table.
examples.zh: 男服務生為我們桌端上了一杯檸檬水。

examples.en: We gave the attentive waiter a generous tip for outstanding dining service.
examples.zh: 我們給了這位體貼周到的服務生一筆豐厚的小費，以酬謝他卓越的用餐服務。

examples.en: The waiter recited tonight's chef's special recommendations with enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 服務生熱情洋溢地向大家娓娓道來今晚主廚精心特製的招牌私房菜。

examples.en: Convenience stores treat every customer with courtesy.
examples.zh: 便利商店對待每位顧客都彬彬有禮。

examples.en: Understanding customer feedback is crucial for improving product quality.
examples.zh: 深入理解顧客的反饋意見對於改善並提升產品質量至關重要。

examples.en: Loyal customers enjoy special VIP privileges and seasonal member discounts.
examples.zh: 忠實顧客享有專屬的貴賓尊榮禮遇與當季會員特惠折扣。

examples.en: TSMC is Taiwan's world-leading semiconductor company.
examples.zh: 台積電是台灣引領全球的半導體公司。

examples.en: Thank you for keeping me company while I waited for the late train.
examples.zh: 謝謝你在我等候晚點列車時一路陪著我作伴。

examples.en: He founded a software startup company that grew into a multinational tech firm.
examples.zh: 他創立了一家軟體新創公司，如今已茁壯發展為跨國科技大企業。

examples.en: Our head office is situated near the central metro station.
examples.zh: 我們的總辦公室位於中央捷運站附近。

examples.en: Many professionals work from home instead of commuting to the downtown office daily.
examples.zh: 許多專業人士選擇居家遠距辦公，而無需每日舟車勞頓通勤至市區辦公室。

examples.en: The doctor's private office is quiet, well-lit, and lined with medical journals.
examples.zh: 這位醫師的私人辦公診間清幽明亮，整齊陳列著各類權威醫學期刊。

examples.en: I had lunch with my colleagues at the canteen.
examples.zh: 我和同事們在員工餐廳一起吃午餐。

examples.en: Trust between colleagues is vital for efficient team project collaboration.
examples.zh: 同事之間的信任對於高效率的團隊專案合作至關重要。

examples.en: We organized a farewell party for our esteemed colleague who is retiring next week.
examples.zh: 我們為即將於下週光榮榮退的敬重同事籌辦了一場溫馨的歡送會。

examples.en: The boss praised our team for exceeding this quarter's goal.
examples.zh: 老闆讚揚我們團隊超越了本季目標。

examples.en: A great boss leads by positive example and listens attentively to employee ideas.
examples.zh: 一位卓越的主管會以身作則、樹立典範，並專注傾聽基層同仁的想法。

examples.en: Don't boss people around; cooperation works far better than giving harsh commands.
examples.zh: 別對別人頤指氣使發號施令，平等的相互協作遠勝於生硬強勢的命令。

examples.en: The company provides excellent health insurance for all employees.
examples.zh: 公司為全體員工提供優質的健保福利。

examples.en: Happy and valued employees are more productive, creative, and loyal.
examples.zh: 感到幸福且備受重視的員工往往更具生產力、創新力與團隊忠誠度。

examples.en: New employees participate in a comprehensive orientation week to learn company culture.
examples.zh: 新進員工參加為期一週的新人培訓計畫，以深入了解公司組織文化。

examples.en: Employers must provide a safe working environment.
examples.zh: 雇主必須提供安全無虞的工作環境。

examples.en: Top employers offer flexible remote work options and continuous professional development.
examples.zh: 頂尖優質雇主提供彈性遠距上班模式與持續性的在職專業進修機會。

examples.en: Mutual respect between employees and employers fosters long-term business success.
examples.zh: 勞資雙方彼此相互尊重與理解，是締造企業長期卓越成功的關鍵。

examples.en: Employees receive their monthly salary on the fifth.
examples.zh: 員工在每月五號領取月薪。

examples.en: Negotiations for a starting salary should reflect your market skills and experience.
examples.zh: 起薪待遇的協商洽談應客觀反映出你在市場上的專業技能與經驗價值。

examples.en: Many companies award annual bonuses in addition to employees' standard base salary.
examples.zh: 除了標準基本月薪之外，許多企業還會發放豐厚的年終獎金。

examples.en: Prepare thoroughly before going to a job interview.
examples.zh: 去求職面試前應做好充分準備。

examples.en: The television network broadcasted a live interview with the championship-winning coach.
examples.zh: 電視新聞網現場直播了對冠軍教練的深度專訪。

examples.en: She answered every tough interview question with composure and confidence.
examples.zh: 她沉著冷靜、自信滿滿地回答了面試官提出的每一個刁鑽問題。

examples.en: Highlight your language skills and internships on your resume.
examples.zh: 在履歷表上突顯你的語言能力和實習經歷。

examples.en: Tailor your resume carefully to match the specific job requirements.
examples.zh: 根據具體職務的任職要求精心量身打造並調整你的履歷表內容。

examples.en: The HR manager reviewed hundreds of resumes before shortlisting five top candidates.
examples.zh: 人力資源經理在審閱了數百份求職履歷後，最終篩選出五位決選人選。
